```sql
select cbsa_title as label,
       owner_median_income as value_high,
       owner_median_income_moe as label_high,
       fmr_2 as value_low,
       fmr_2 as label_low
from doorstep.mart_metro_year c
join doorstep.fct_metro_year fm
on c.cbsa_title = fm.cbsa_title
and c.year = 2015
and c.cbsa_title in ('Peoria, IL', 'Scranton--Wilkes-Barre, PA')
where c.year >= 2015
and c.cbsa_title in ('Peoria, IL', 'Scranton--Wilkes-Barre, PA')
group by cbsa_title, owner_median_income, owner_median_income_moe, fmr_2
order by label_low asc
```
